About these projects

Seven end-to-end analysis projects. Each one starts from a business question, uses an editable assumptions sheet and formula-driven data, and ends in a dashboard with a recommendation. They are built on realistic sample data modelled on real business scenarios, so no client or employer data is shown. Targets and assumptions are illustrative and can be changed.
